headline: Transmission to address re-curtailment

highlights: Soft quarter: CESC reported revenue (including regulatory income) of INR 57 bn in Q2FY27, up 7% YoY in line with our and consensus estimates.
EBITDA was flat YoY to INR 11.4 bn, impacted by increased personnel costs, power purchase costs and other expenses.

PAT stood at INR 4.4 bn, down 2% YoY,was lower than 6% by our and consensus estimates, Distribution volumes witnessed healthy growth; generation performance remained mixed: CESC's distribution business reported a 7% YoY increase in sales volumes during Q2FY27.
Standalone CESC volumes grew 7% YoY to 3.5 BU, while Noida Power registered 11% growth to 1.3 BU, supported by an improvement in T&D losses to 13.9% from 15.0% in the previous year.
valuation: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating BUY BUY Target Price 195 204 Sales (INR mn) 245,431 270,306 246,097 270,018 % Chng.
For FY29E capacity target of 4.5GW till Date PPA is signed for 4.3GW (incl 1.4GW to be acquired capacity).

Reflecting the hurdles in renewables and the weak Malegaon performance, we cut our FY27E/FY28E EPS estimates by 3% each and lower our target price to INR 195 (from INR 204), while retaining our BUY rating.
